title: C-betting by texture
description: Six questions on flop textures, range advantage, and sizing.

questions.prompt: Which board most strongly favours the preflop raiser in a single-raised pot?
questions.explanation: Dry K-high rainbow is the prototypical raiser-favoured board. The raiser holds many more KX, pocket pairs, and overcards than the caller. Range-bet small at high frequency.

questions.prompt: When you have a clear range advantage on a dry board, the recommended c-bet sizing is:

choices.text: 25–33% pot range bet — charge the whole pot a small amount.

questions.explanation: Range advantage favours small, high-frequency bets so the equity edge compounds across the wide range. Big polarised bets are the right tool only when you have *nut* advantage on a wet board.

questions.prompt: In a 3-bet pot IP at 100bb effective on a dry K-high board, your typical c-bet frequency at 33% pot should be approximately:
questions.explanation: In 3BPs the raiser's range is much narrower and stronger, and SPR is ~5. Solvers c-bet near 90%+ at 33% pot on dry boards in this configuration.

questions.prompt: On a 6♠ 5♥ 4♣ flop in a single-raised pot, the preflop raiser should usually c-bet at high frequency to put pressure on the caller.
questions.explanation: The caller's range crushes 6-5-4 — they have many sets, two-pairs, and straights. The raiser's overcards are often dominated. Check most of the range here.

questions.prompt: Which board features should drive your c-bet sizing decision? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Whether the pot is single-raised or 3-bet.
The colour of the chips you used preflop.

questions.explanation: Connectivity, suitedness, pairing, and pot type are the four axes. Chip colour is irrelevant — never trust ‘flow’ explanations over board structure.

questions.prompt: On a wet middling board (e.g. 9♣ 8♥ 7♦) where the preflop caller has a slight nut advantage, the appropriate c-bet posture is:

choices.text: C-bet 100% at 33% pot — the raiser still has range advantage.
Use a polarised 50–75% pot bet at lower frequency, mixed with checks.
Always check — there is no reason to bet on this texture.
Overbet small with junk hands and bluffs only.

questions.explanation: Wet textures with marginal nut advantage call for a polarised 50–75% sizing at moderate frequency. Pure checking gives up too much; small range-bets get raised by the caller's strong made hands.
